edition: Silent Hill 2, original continuity (2001). The examination video predates the remake.

sources.nature: English translation of Konami’s Book of Lost Memories, Silent Hill 2 Creature Commentary, pp. 48–49. In the section on the unseen prison monster, the commentary ties the voice in the cell to the creature named prisoner. It supplies no creature silhouette.

Firsthand inspection of the level using a camera modification. The 90-second recording was sampled at one-second intervals, native cells 160×90. Changing the camera angle shows cell surfaces, bars and James. The sampled views do not establish a visible actor or a sprite outline; this observation makes no claim that no underlying technical model can exist.

decision: The audio cue, empty cell, reticle, and a possible hit response do not depict the Prisoner. Do not add a body or turn an invisible presence into an illustration. No generation.
